dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.app-sandbox: Required for every Mac App Store app.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.developer.ubiquity-kvstore-ide: Syncs ishare settings and uploaders between the user's Macs with iCloud key-value storage.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.application-groups: Shares the upload history snapshot with the Recent Uploads widget and files with the Share menu extension.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.assets.pictures.read-: Saves screenshots and recordings to the Pictures folder, the default save location.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.device.audio-input: Records the microphone into screen recordings when the user turns it on.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.device.camera: Shows the optional webcam bubble over screen recordings.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.files.bookmarks.app-s: Remembers save and watch folders the user picked outside Pictures.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.files.user-selected.r: Opens, uploads and saves files the user picks.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.network.client: Uploads captures to Imgur, the user's server or S3-compatible storage.
dev.adrian.ishare.com.apple.security.network.server: Serves a capture the user explicitly chooses to share on the local network from a temporary link with a random unguessable path, which expires after the time the user picks or when ishare quits.
Adds captures to a Photos album when the user sets up a Photos uploader; access is requested only then, and assets are removed only when the user deletes the upload from the history.
dev.adrian.ishare.keychain-access-groups: Stores the S3 secret access keys and optional default link passwords the user enters as iCloud Keychain items so they reach the user's other Macs; no other data is kept in the shared keychain group.

dev.adrian.ishare.cli.com.apple.security.app-sandbox: Required for every executable in a Mac App Store app, including the bundled ishare command-line tool.
dev.adrian.ishare.cli.com.apple.security.application-groups: Writes the user's command-line request to the shared container and reads the app's reply.

dev.adrian.ishare.sharemenuext.com.apple.security.app-sandbox: Required for every Mac App Store extension.
dev.adrian.ishare.sharemenuext.com.apple.security.application-groups: Hands the shared file to the ishare app for uploading.
dev.adrian.ishare.sharemenuext.com.apple.security.files.user-selected.r: Reads the file the user shares from the Share menu.

dev.adrian.ishare.widgets.com.apple.security.app-sandbox: Required for every Mac App Store extension.
dev.adrian.ishare.widgets.com.apple.security.application-groups: Reads the recent uploads snapshot and thumbnails the ishare app writes to the shared container.
